tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search of The Korean Today articles, newest first. Korean keywords work best for the Korean edition; use lang for another edition or to get translated summaries.

tools.name: latest_articles
tools.description: Most recent articles, optionally by section and language.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Full text and metadata of one article by id or URL. With lang, also returns the AI summary in that language and links to other language editions. Members-only articles return metadata only.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: News sections with slugs and article counts.

tools.name: krw_exchange_rates
tools.description: Today's base rates in South Korean won (KRW per unit) for about 43 currencies, from public official sources only: Export-Import Bank of Korea and Bank of Korea (ECOS). tools.name: holidays
tools.description: National public holidays for 20 countries (KR US JP CN VN TH PH ID IN DE GB FR AU CA BR MX AE SG HK TW) and closures of 9 stock exchanges (XKRX XNYS XNAS XJPX XHKG XSHG XLON XTAI XSES), computed from official calendars with python-holidays. Default window: today to +7 days (KST). Max 60 days.

tools.name: open_pharmacies
